by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h ϑ ih =>
    intro hϑ_gt_0
    cases ϑ with
    | zero => omega
    | succ k =>
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · subst k
        simpa [δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat] using
          hC_proximityGapAffineLines
      · have ih_k :
          δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
            (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := k) (e := e) (ε := ε) :=
          ih k (Nat.lt_succ_self k) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk)
        intro u hu
        let U₀ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := k) u).1
        let U₁ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := k) u).2
        have h_prob_split :
            Pr_{ let r_last ← $ᵖ F;
                 let r_init ← $ᵖ (Fin k → F) }[
              multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close
                (MC := MC) (u := u) (e := e) r_last r_init]
              > (((Nat.cast (R := ℝ≥0) (k + 1)) * ε : ℝ≥0) /
                  (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0)) := by
          simpa [multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close] using hu
        have h_prob_R :
            Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[
              r ∈ R_star_tensor MC (m := k) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁]
              > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
          simpa [U₀, U₁] using
            (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε)
              (ϑ := k) u e h_prob_split)
        have h_joint_of_mem :
            ∀ r : R_star_tensor MC (m := k) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁,
              jointProximityNat
                (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r.val)
                (e := e) (C := MC) := by
          simpa [U₀, U₁] using
            (correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
              (MC := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε) (ϑ_pred := k)
              ih_k u)
        have h_prob_mono :
            Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[
              r ∈ R_star_tensor MC (m := k) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁]
              ≤ Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[
                jointProximityNat
                  (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r)
                  (e := e) (C := MC)] := by
          apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
          intro r hr
          exact h_joint_of_mem ⟨r, hr⟩
        have h_prob_close :
            Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[
              jointProximityNat
                (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r)
                (e := e) (C := MC)]
              > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le h_prob_R h_prob_mono
        have h_prob_interleaved :
            Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[
              Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁) r,
                MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ k))) ≤ e]
              > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
          simpa [jointProximityNat, affineLineEvaluation] using h_prob_close
        have h_pair :=
          (h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ k) (by positivity))
            (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁) h_prob_interleaved
        simpa [jointProximityNat₂, jointProximityNat, U₀, U₁,
          splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords, finMapTwoWords] using h_pair
